subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice field harmonization & PO mapping
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenfield-supply.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice template and PO mapping

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the warm welcome — we're excited to be activated as a vendor for Redwood. Before we go live, Procurement asked that we confirm the invoice ingestion expectations. A couple quick questions so our finance team can prepare the first batch: 

- Do you prefer invoices via the portal or should we continue sending to billing@redwoodinference.com as a fallback?
- Can a single PDF include multiple POs (and multiple line items per PO)? If so, do you need a PO column per line item or a PO header row?
- Are there required columns/fields you need in a CSV/Excel template (e.g., invoice_number, invoice_date, vendor_tax_id, po_number, line_description, qty, unit_price, tax, total, remittance_address)?

Attached is the template our AP team typically uses (greenfield_invoice_template_v1.xlsx) — it's flexible and we can reformat. Also attaching a sample CSV that shows how we export multi-PO invoices.

Would appreciate a short confirmation so we can turn the export on Wednesday.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Greenfield Supply Co.
Attachment: greenfield_invoice_template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: sample-po-mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenfield-supply.com>, billing@greenfield-supply.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice template and PO mapping

Hi Sofia — welcome, and thanks for sending the template.

Quick note from our side while Laura (Procurement) confirms mapping: we strongly prefer portal submissions for higher throughput and traceability, but we do allow an email fallback under the following conditions:

- Email subject must include the Account ID and PO numbers (example: "GF-ACCT-12345 | PO: 98765; 98766").
- Attachments must be individual PDFs per invoice (no concatenated PDFs where the invoice metadata is missing). If you need to include multiple POs on one invoice, ensure the CSV/Excel has a PO column on each line item.

I'll let Laura confirm the exact column set and any filename conventions. Attaching a one-page PoC mapping we use for new vendors — it lists required vs optional fields.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vendor-field-mapping-onepage.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenfield-supply.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice template and PO mapping

Hi Sofia — welcome onboard. A few required items from Procurement / AP to make ingestion smooth: 

Required fields (per line item when using CSV/Excel):
- po_number
- invoice_number
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- line_description
- quantity (integer)
- unit_price (decimal)
- line_total (decimal)
- currency (ISO 4217)

Required invoice-level fields (if sending PDF):
- vendor_name
- vendor_tax_id (VAT/GST if applicable)
- remittance_address
- total_amount
- contact_email for payment queries

Rules / notes:
- Multi-PO invoice: allowed. Each line must include a po_number. If sending a single PDF that represents multiple invoices, include a CSV companion file (same filename base) that contains line-level mapping.
- Filename convention for email fallback: GF-<vendor>-INV-<YYYYMMDD>-<invoice_number>.pdf; subject must contain the primary PO(s).
- For portal uploads we accept a single combined PDF per invoice (portal associates it to PO automatically).

SLA: AP will acknowledge receipt within 24 hours for portal uploads and within 48 hours for email fallback.

I'll paste a minimal sample row below you can test against. If you want, we can schedule a quick 20-minute call tomorrow to validate your export.

Sample CSV row:
po_number,invoice_number,invoice_date,line_description,quantity,unit_price,line_total,currency
98765,INV-2026-045,2026-08-01,Replacement filters,2,150.00,300.00,USD

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenfield-supply.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice template and PO mapping

Thanks Laura — very helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 

1) Subject token: if we include multiple PO numbers should we separate them with commas or semicolons in the subject line? Example: "GF-ACCT-12345 | PO: 98765,98766" vs "GF-ACCT-12345 | PO: 98765; 98766"
2) Companion CSV for multi-PO PDFs: can the CSV be nested inside a zip (we currently bundle PDFs + CSV into a zip for batch sends) or does the parser require the CSV as a top-level attachment?
3) Our export tool currently uses dates in MM/DD/YYYY. We'll move to YYYY-MM-DD, but can you confirm you will accept MM/DD/YYYY for a 2-week pilot?

Attached a sample export (sample-po-mapping.csv). We'll schedule the test upload once we have the filename/subject format nailed.

Best,
Sofia
Attachment: sample-po-mapping.csv (text/csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@greenfield-supply.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice template and PO mapping

Hi Sofia — thanks for the sample and the questions. Finalizing answers here so your engineering/finance teams have a single source: 

1) Subject token separator: use commas (no spaces) to list PO numbers in the subject. Example we will parse: "GF-ACCT-12345 | PO: 98765,98766". Avoid semicolons.

2) Companion CSV: we can accept a zipped bundle (.zip) that contains PDFs + one top-level CSV named exactly as the zip base (e.g., GF-Greenfield-20260801.zip contains GF-Greenfield-20260801.csv). Our ingestion service will unzip and look for the CSV at the root. 

3) Date format during pilot: we'll accept MM/DD/YYYY for the two-week onboarding window as long as you include the timezone in the export header (e.g., invoice_date_tz). After pilot we require YYYY-MM-DD.

Operational notes and next steps:
- File naming: GF-Greenfield-INV-YYYYMMDD-<invoice_number>.pdf (or .zip)
- Email fallback subject: include account token and PO list as above
- Test window: please upload 5 sample documents via the portal tomorrow morning (we'll watch logs). If you need portal creds, Karthik will send the invite link.

I'll follow up with the portal invite and the short test checklist (upload steps + expected ack). Thanks again, looking forward to the test.

Regards,
Monica Patel
AP Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Related link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Xabc-example
Attachment: onboarding-test-checklist.pdf (pdf)
